summary: Iteration 48 silent-strip RETEST on Jon Casile (LP smart, e2ce35b8-...). RESULT: SILENT-STRIP IS FIXED. Human-eye + network trace confirms: (1) Each of the four LP trade-spec selects (panel_size, wrap_trim_width_in, fascia_width_in, batten_spacing_in) fires ONE PUT /api/estimates/{id} whose body carries the picked value. Observed 4 individual PUTs during the sequence 4x8 -> wrap 6 -> fascia 12 -> batten 16, and the 'Saved' toast appears each time (saveSpec uses the toasting save()). (2) Immediately after the four flips, GET /api/estimates/{id} returns {panel_size:'4x8', wrap_trim_width_in:6, fascia_width_in:12, batten_spacing_in:16}. (3) Full page reload -> all four selects render the saved values. (4) In addition to the four spec fields, buildPayload now carries shake_reveal_in, color_tier, lp_soffit_type (undefined-stripped when not applicable, so payload key count differs but the fields ride the payload). REGRESSION: waste_pct / margin_pct / line qty edits still autosave and still toast 'Saved'. LIVE RE-DERIVE GAP (worth Howard's eye): the LP MATERIAL LIST PANEL's internal preview state IS refetched on lp-flag-checklist-changed (backend preview correctly returns 38 Series 4' x 8' Panel qty=84, 540 Series 5/4" x 6" qty=124, 440 Series 4/4" x 12" qty=21 after PUT) -- BUT the visible LP tab line rows are the section-accordion rendering of est.lines, which is not re-derived on PUT alone. Result the contractor sees on the same session, no reload: the estimate tab still shows 4' x 10' Panel qty=68, 5/4" x 4" trim qty=62, 4/4" x 8" fascia qty=21 (the STORED lines). A reload doesn't fix it either -- the stored lines only rebuild on HOVER import / materialize. So 'the LP package panel re-derives live' is only half-true: the derived counts are live in the preview API and in whatever surface renders pkg lines, but the SectionAccordion rows on the estimator tab do NOT re-render 68 -> 84 / rename 4x10 -> 4x8 until the next import/materialize. Coil-colour chips render correctly with the amber fallback text 'colour not set - set in Job Info' on the six catalog rows (3 rows x 2 sections) on the vinyl tab of a siding estimate (red house). Whole-units check on Jon Casile: every visible qty on every visible tab is an integer (38 Series Soffit Vented qty=12, Closed qty=9; 540 Series Trim 5/4" x 4" qty=62; 190 Series Trim qty=129; 440 Series Trim qty=21). No fractional qty anywhere.

rca_of_re_derive_gap.why: SectionAccordion rows use est.lines (the stored merge of catalog + saved qtys), not pkg from LpMaterialListPanel. saveSpec fires PUT + window.dispatchEvent('lp-flag-checklist-changed'). The listener in LpMaterialListPanel (line 177) refetches the preview and updates its own pkg state — but the section-accordion rows on the LP tab render est.lines, which only rebuild on HOVER import / materialize server-side. Until est.lines is refreshed (either by re-fetching /api/estimates/{id} into est-state after PUT, or by calling POST /api/estimates/{id}/lp-package/materialize after PUT), the visible line rename+recount will not appear on the LP tab. Backend materialize is proven (iter_48 test 10/10, still passing) to do the rename+recount correctly.
rca_of_re_derive_gap.mitigation_suggested: After saveSpec's PUT returns (or after the lp-flag-checklist-changed dispatch), auto-fire POST /api/estimates/{id}/lp-package/materialize, then merge the returned lines into est.lines (or refetch GET /api/estimates/{id}). Alternatively, render the LP tab lines from pkg (LpMaterialListPanel) when a package is available, so the visible qtys track the live derivation instead of the stored snapshot. Current UX: the 'Saved' toast tells the contractor the value stuck, but he sees no rename/recount on the material rows until his next import.

But note: lp_soffit_type and color_tier still use plain update() (debounced autosave), while the LP dimensional specs use saveSpec (immediate save). Minor inconsistency; both persist through buildPayload now, but the panel re-derive event only fires on saveSpec, not on lp_soffit_type/color_tier changes.

The LP MATERIAL LIST PANEL prints a note 'quantities & provenance live on the group tab lines below' — the group tab lines are stored (est.lines) and don't re-derive on PUT. Two truths on one page (preview live vs stored) confuse the contractor after a spec change. Either wire the LP tab rows to pkg, or auto-materialize after saveSpec.
